==Description==
'''UI-157''' is the 7th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-157''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

'''UI-157''' behaves just like [[UI-110]] rushing to the door very quickly before despawning, just a bit slower than [[UI-110]].

== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide immediately when you hear him, since its very fast.

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-157''' was added as a joke.
